claim: RWCR saturates at rural d=20: the non-default baselines' best RWCR lie within 0.01
survives_calibrated_channel: yes (spread 0.0025; cell unaffected); but saturation BREAKS in rural d=80 (0.136) and urban d=20 (0.413)
survives_sumo: no at rural d=20 (spread 0.0130 vs the 0.01 threshold)
verdict: exploratory: holds at rural d=20 in the fallback simulator (spread 0.0025) and under R9, but not on SUMO (0.013) or in the dense calibrated cells

claim: The per-cell best baseline differs from cell to cell
One fixed setting (dvcast(n_slots=30)) is within 13% of per-cell tuning in every headline cell

survives_sumo: no (best fixed slotted_1p(n_slots=50); fails q* in 1 cell(s))
verdict: exploratory (backend- and setting-dependent; R3: best-fixed identity unstable)
